meta.inherited: color-base-*, color-red..pink, mono-0/100 are Obsidian core defaults (docs.obsidian.md, Foundations/Colors), not defined in the repo.

tokens.name: background-primary
tokens.usage: The editor and note ground. Light uses base-00 (white); dark flips to base-20 so the editor sits lighter than the sidebars.

tokens.name: background-primary-alt
tokens.usage: A 3% ink wash over background-primary for inset areas (code blocks, embeds). Source: rgb(var(--mono-rgb-100), 3%).

tokens.name: background-secondary
tokens.usage: Sidebars, modals and the unfocused-window fill of glass controls. Light is a step darker than the editor; dark is the darkest ground.

tokens.name: card-background
tokens.usage: Bases card view and other cards. Dark lifts cards to base-35 so they read above the editor.

tokens.name: background-glass
tokens.usage: Normal liquid glass: menus, command-palette results. Always paired with backdrop-filter-glass-<theme> and glass-shadow-inset-l plus shadow-card.

tokens.name: background-glass-subtle
tokens.usage: Subtle liquid glass: notices, the command-palette input. Paired with backdrop-filter-glass-subtle-<theme>.

tokens.name: text-normal
tokens.usage: Body and UI text on background-primary, background-secondary and both glass fills.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: suggestion prefixes, slider values, descriptions. 55% ink over the ground (source: rgb(var(--mono-rgb-100), 55%)). Measures 4.8:1 light, 5.5:1 dark on background-primary.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled and placeholder text only. At 25% ink it does not meet 4.5:1 on any ground; never use it for text that must be read.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (selected menu item, selected suggestion, mod-cta). Set with !important in the theme for every accent.

tokens.name: text-muted-on-accent
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside an accent-filled row (a selected suggestion prefix).

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links and the selected sidebar item label. On background-primary: 3.5:1 light, 4.5:1 dark (below 4.5:1, kept exact).

tokens.name: text-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover.

tokens.name: text-error
tokens.usage: Error text and warning menu items (menu-item.is-warning).

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text.

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: Success text.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The active accent. Set to Blue in this system (the Glassive theme ships Indigo); the Style Settings "Accent Color" option repoints it to any accent-* palette. Selected menu items, selected suggestions, toggled toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: color-accent-1
tokens.usage: Accent lifted 4% toward white: interactive-accent fills (mod-cta, selected rows). Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent), white 4%), computed here for Blue. White text on it: 3.3:1 light, 3.1:1 dark (below 4.5:1, kept exact from the source).

tokens.name: color-accent-2
tokens.usage: Accent lifted 10% toward white: hover state of accent fills and links. Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent), white 10%), computed here for Blue.

tokens.name: interactive-accent
tokens.usage: Fill of call-to-action buttons and toggled liquid toolbar text buttons; text on it is text-on-accent.

tokens.name: interactive-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of interactive-accent.

tokens.name: interactive-normal
tokens.usage: Resting fill of standard buttons.

tokens.name: interactive-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of standard buttons.

tokens.name: background-modifier-form-field
tokens.usage: Input and textarea fill.

tokens.name: background-modifier-hover-exsubtle
tokens.usage: Faintest hover wash. Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--mono-100) 3.5%, transparent), the same ink at 3.5% alpha.

tokens.name: background-modifier-hover-subtle
tokens.usage: Subtle hover wash. Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--mono-100) 5%, transparent), the same ink at 5% alpha.

tokens.name: background-modifier-hover
tokens.usage: Default hover wash and the selected sidebar item fill. Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--mono-100) 7.5%, transparent), the same ink at 7.5% alpha.

tokens.name: background-modifier-hover-strong
tokens.usage: Strong hover wash; also the 1px border of glass panels. Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--mono-100) 12%, transparent), the same ink at 12% alpha.

tokens.name: background-modifier-active-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an active item: the accent at 10% (computed here for Blue). Source: hsl(var(--interactive-accent-hsl), 10%).

tokens.name: background-modifier-border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and the 1px ring around inputs and search fields.

tokens.name: background-modifier-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quieter hairline for nested surfaces.

tokens.name: background-modifier-seperator
tokens.usage: Separators: the rule above modal button rows and the halo on modal buttons. Name spelled as in the source.

tokens.name: background-modifier-border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a 2px ring of the accent at 60% around focused inputs (computed here for Blue). Source: hsl(var(--interactive-accent-hsl), 60%). At 60% alpha the ring lands 2.1:1 light and 2.5:1 dark on background-primary, under the 3:1 focus-ring floor; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: background-modifier-error
tokens.usage: Destructive fills: mod-destructive at 25%, mod-destructive.mod-cta at 90%.

tokens.name: background-modifier-success
tokens.usage: Success fills.

tokens.name: text-selection
tokens.usage: Text selection: the accent at 20% (computed here for Blue).

tokens.name: text-highlight-bg
tokens.usage: Highlighted ==text== background, same yellow in both themes.

tokens.name: nav-item-background-selected
tokens.usage: Selected file-tree row: the accent at 15% (computed here for Blue). Source: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 15%, transparent).

tokens.name: table-text-color
tokens.usage: Table body text: text-normal at 70%. Source: color-mix(in oklch, text-normal 70%, transparent). Headers stay text-normal.

tokens.name: table-selection
tokens.usage: Selected table cells: the accent at 10% (computed here for Blue).

tokens.name: top-header-bg
tokens.usage: Tab bar and active view header ground. Light is a near-white just under base-00; dark matches the editor.

tokens.name: accent-red
tokens.usage: The Red accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-red). White text-on-accent on it: 3.6:1 light, 3.4:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: The Orange accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-orange). White text-on-accent on it: 2.3:1 light, 2.3:1 dark. Fails even 3:1; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-yellow
tokens.usage: The Yellow accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-yellow). White text-on-accent on it: 1.5:1 light, 1.4:1 dark. Fails even 3:1; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-green
tokens.usage: The Green accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-green). White text-on-accent on it: 2.2:1 light, 2.0:1 dark. Fails even 3:1; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-mint
tokens.usage: The Mint accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-mint). White text-on-accent on it: 2.1:1 light, 1.8:1 dark. Fails even 3:1; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: The Teal accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-teal). White text-on-accent on it: 2.2:1 light, 1.9:1 dark. Fails even 3:1; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: The Cyan accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-cyan). White text-on-accent on it: 2.2:1 light, 1.7:1 dark. Fails even 3:1; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: The Blue accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-blue). This system's default accent. White text-on-accent on it: 3.5:1 light, 3.2:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-indigo
tokens.usage: The Indigo accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-indigo). The theme's shipped default. White text-on-accent on it: 5.0:1 light, 3.6:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: The Purple accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-purple). White text-on-accent on it: 4.2:1 light, 3.6:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: The Pink accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-pink). White text-on-accent on it: 3.6:1 light, 3.5:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-brown
tokens.usage: The Brown accent palette (Style Settings: theme-glassive-accent-brown). White text-on-accent on it: 3.6:1 light, 3.0:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-obsidian
tokens.usage: "Obsidian Default" option: uses the vault accent (--accent-h/s/l). Shown with Obsidian's stock 258 88% 66%. White text-on-accent on it: 4.3:1 light, 4.3:1 dark. Below 4.5:1 for 13px row text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: color-base-00
tokens.usage: Light: page and form-field ground. Dark: the darkest ground, used for background-secondary (sidebars, modals). Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-05
tokens.usage: Inherited step; Glassive does not reference it directly. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-10
tokens.usage: interactive-hover ground. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-20
tokens.usage: Light: background-secondary (sidebars, modals). Dark: background-primary (the editor). Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-25
tokens.usage: Inherited step; Glassive does not reference it directly. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-30
tokens.usage: Light theme: hover, pressed and selected fill of liquid toolbar buttons. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-35
tokens.usage: Hover fill of modal footer buttons; dark-theme card-background. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-40
tokens.usage: Inherited border step (Obsidian border-focus default; Glassive overrides focus with the accent). Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-50
tokens.usage: Inherited step; Glassive does not reference it directly. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-60
tokens.usage: Inherited step; Glassive does not reference it directly. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-70
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a destructive call-to-action button. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: color-base-100
tokens.usage: text-normal: body and UI text. Inherited from Obsidian core, not set by Glassive.

tokens.name: mono-0
tokens.usage: Opposite of ink: white in light, black in dark. Inherited from Obsidian core.

tokens.name: mono-100
tokens.usage: Pure ink: black in light, white in dark. Glass controls set their text and icon color to it. Inherited from Obsidian core.

spacing.note: Examples: open the Spacing page under Components → Foundations. It shows every token below on the part it spaces, with the space highlighted, and the control heights at real size.
